input._script:
using JSON3
import JACC
JACC.@init_backend
using CUDA
out = Dict{String,Any}()
out["backend"] = string(JACC.default_backend())
n = 50000
x = JACC.array(collect(1.0:n))
try
    r = JACC.@parallel_reduce range = n ((i, a) -> a[i] * a[i])(x)
    out["type"] = string(typeof(r))
    out["is_number"] = r isa Number
    try; out["array_readback"] = Array(r)[1]; catch e; out["array_readback_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200); end
    try; out["plain_index"] = CUDA.@allowscalar r[1]; catch e; out["plain_index_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200); end
    out["expected"] = sum(abs2, 1.0:n)
catch e
    out["err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 400)
end
try
    r2 = JACC.@parallel_reduce range = 7 ((i, a) -> a[i] - a[i] + 1.0)(x)
    out["small_type"] = string(typeof(r2)); out["small_val"] = Array(r2)[1]
catch e
    out["small_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 300)
end
try
    r3 = JACC.@parallel_reduce range = 0 ((i, a) -> a[i])(x)
    out["zero"] = string(typeof(r3), " ", Array(r3)[1])
catch e
    out["zero_err"] = first(sprint(showerror, e), 200)
end
out["jacc_version"] = string(pkgversion(JACC))
println(JSON3.write(out))
